integrity: Equations were transcribed from the original public full text; proofs use sign and comparison inequalities. Finite code is supportive only, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: A model-theoretic claim on above-capacity data only; no empirical prediction, global below-capacity result, or positive continuation of the Euler map beyond the first nonpositive prey state.
title: Over-capacity runaway and step-independent positivity loss in a Smith predator–prey model
